jobs.tierReason: review of merge-queue changes: which checks run for a batch and how batch size adapts
jobs.prompt: Review coordination/review/affected.diff (merge queue wiring) with the new modules affected.mjs and adaptive-batch.mjs and the design in docs/plans/phase15-lessons-design.md section 9. Rules that must hold: (1) a batch can never pass because a check was skipped or narrowed by mistake: every doubt (no map, stale map, unknown or non-code file, config or lockfile or test helper, new files, too wide, last batch, bisected halves, fullEvery counter) must run the normal full check, and a skipped check must only happen when the selection says no test is affected; (2) the fullEvery counter and the last-batch rule cannot be bypassed by bisecting, conflicts, requeues, resumed passes or concurrent checks; (3) a changed file path from a worker (with .. or absolute or odd characters) cannot make the selection wrong or inject extra arguments into the check command (the affected test paths are put into argv: check they cannot become flags, e.g. a path starting with a dash); (4) the stale repo map risk: a map built before the batch must not cause a missing test to be treated as not affected; (5) adaptive batch size can never exceed 100, never go below 1, and a failed batch always steps down; the loop terminates and never skips or repeats plans; (6) rollback, journal and security gate behavior are unchanged; the check results keep their shape for existing readers. Find real bugs with file and line evidence, rank high, medium, low, and say how to fix each. Do not edit files.
